heading: Photography Exhibition
intro: Through my lens, as A Zay Shot.

photos.caption: Devil’s Corridor
photos.alt: Black and white photograph looking down a long, empty covered walkway with concrete pillars and a patterned block wall

photos.caption: Weight of Small Things
photos.alt: Black and white photograph of a young boy standing on a road, holding a speckled chicken in his arms and looking directly at the camera, with utility poles and distant pedestrians behind him.

photos.caption: The Proocession
photos.alt: Horse riders dressed in colourful traditional attire move together during a cultural carnival. Photographed from behind, the scene captures a moment of movement, cultural expression and collective celebration.

photos.caption: Hold My Hand
photos.alt: Two women in rust-orange hijabs lean their heads together with eyes closed, seen from below against a mustard wall and teal sky

photos.caption: The Joy of Being Young
photos.alt: Five young girls share a playful moment at home in Kaduna. Their laughter, smiles and spontaneous gestures capture the warmth, freedom and simple joys of childhood.

photos.caption: Chronicles of Kasuwan Kawo
photos.alt: A yellow commercial minibus in motion, blurred, passing trees and a rust-coloured roof

photos.caption: Identity
photos.alt: Close portrait of a woman in profile wearing a purple and turquoise patterned head wrap and a gold triangular earring, looking to the side

photos.caption: Before the City Sleeps
photos.alt: A yellow tricycle move through a busy street in Kaduna, Nigeria, beneath a sky fading from golden orange to deep teal. Pedestrians, vehicles and roadside activity capture the rhythm of everyday life as daylight gives way to evening.

photos.caption: Threshold
photos.alt: A broken window frame with jagged glass, glowing peach light and a pale wall beyond, set in deep shadow

photos.caption: Lift
photos.alt: Low-angle close portrait of a woman in a rust-coloured head wrap, face turned up toward a wide teal sky with soft clouds at the edges

photos.caption: Birthday Blues
photos.alt: A black-and-white self-portrait of a woman in a dark headscarf gazing at the camera while holding a vivid blue balloon close to her face.
